lines.text: Jesus and His disciples leave Jericho with a large crowd, and blind Bartimaeus sits beside the road.
Bartimaeus cries out to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy, and many people tell him to be patient.
Jesus stops and says to call him, and Bartimaeus throws off his cloak and comes to Jesus.
Jesus asks what he wants, and Bartimaeus calls Him Rabboni and asks to walk again.
Jesus says his faith has healed him, and immediately he receives his sight and follows Jesus along the road.
